aggregation: Within each 42-window group: window-prediction mean, physical-frame-equal mean, and each horizon mean over 42 windows
teacher_rule: Every teacher_free metric dictionary in the C evaluation must match the hash-bound teacher's correct dictionary at the same start and horizon, with matching decoder, codec, cache and code hashes
limits: Post-hoc source-image-change groups include hand, occlusion, illumination and object changes; these are not tracked 3D object motion, out-of-sample generalization, action success or an independent target. The groups were defined during stage B training.
